title: Telemetrix | Plant telemetry
description: Source-time trends, pump state and collection gaps. Raw Good measurements below six hours; one-minute Good rollups for longer ranges.

list.name: Collection gaps
list.rawSql:
SELECT gap_start AS time,gap_end AS timeend,asset_id||': '||coalesce(reason,'source gap') AS text,
 'gap' AS tags FROM plant_event
 WHERE event_type='Gap' AND asset_id=${asset:sqlstring}
 AND gap_end>=$__timeFrom() AND gap_start<=$__timeTo()

list.name: asset
list.label: Asset
list.query: SELECT asset_id AS __text,asset_id AS __value FROM asset ORDER BY asset_id

list.name: tag
list.label: Tags
list.query: SELECT name AS __text,name AS __value FROM tag WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} ORDER BY name

panels.title: Pump state
panels.description: Source Running tag. Recorded gaps and more than one minute without Good samples remain empty. State ends at its last observed sample.

targets.rawSql:
WITH states AS (
 SELECT m.time,m.value,lag(m.value) OVER(ORDER BY m.time) AS previous,
        lag(m.time) OVER(ORDER BY m.time) AS previous_time,
        lead(m.time) OVER(ORDER BY m.time) AS next_time
 FROM measurement m JOIN tag t USING(tag_id)
 WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time) AND t.asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND t.name='Running' AND m.quality=0
)
SELECT time,value,'Pump state' AS metric FROM states
WHERE previous IS DISTINCT FROM value OR time-previous_time>interval '1 minute'
UNION ALL
SELECT previous_time+interval '1 millisecond',NULL::double precision,'Pump state'
FROM states WHERE time-previous_time>interval '1 minute'
UNION ALL
SELECT time+interval '1 millisecond',NULL::double precision,'Pump state'
FROM states WHERE next_time IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT greatest(gap_start,$__timeFrom()::timestamptz)+interval '1 millisecond',NULL::double precision,'Pump state'
FROM plant_event WHERE asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND event_type='Gap'
AND gap_end>=$__timeFrom() AND gap_start<=$__timeTo()
UNION ALL
SELECT resumed.time,resumed.value,'Pump state'
FROM plant_event g
JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT m.time,m.value FROM measurement m JOIN tag t USING(tag_id)
 WHERE t.asset_id=g.asset_id AND t.name='Running' AND m.quality=0 AND m.time>=g.gap_end
 ORDER BY m.time LIMIT 1
) resumed ON true
WHERE g.asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND g.event_type='Gap'
 AND g.gap_end>=$__timeFrom() AND g.gap_start<=$__timeTo()
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Current pump state
panels.description: State change is bounded by the retained raw history. Select a pump to see its Running tag.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
 SELECT m.tag_id,m.time,m.value FROM measurement m JOIN tag t USING(tag_id)
 WHERE t.asset_id=${asset:sqlstring} AND t.name='Running' AND m.quality=0 ORDER BY m.time DESC LIMIT 1
), previous AS (
 SELECT max(m.time) AS time FROM measurement m JOIN latest l USING(tag_id)
 WHERE m.quality=0 AND m.time<=l.time AND m.value IS DISTINCT FROM l.value
), started AS (
 SELECT min(m.time) AS time FROM measurement m JOIN latest l USING(tag_id) CROSS JOIN previous p
 WHERE m.quality=0 AND m.value=l.value AND m.time>coalesce(p.time,'-infinity'::timestamptz) AND m.time<=l.time
)
SELECT CASE latest.value WHEN 1 THEN 'Running' ELSE 'Stopped' END AS "State",
       started.time AS "Last changed",latest.time AS "Last sample"
FROM latest CROSS JOIN started

panels.title: $asset / $tag
panels.description: Good measurements; six-hour ranges and longer use one-minute rollups. Source gaps and missing history remain blank.

targets.rawSql:
WITH trend AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('${__interval}'::interval,m.time) AS time,avg(m.value) AS value,t.name AS metric
  FROM measurement m JOIN tag t USING(tag_id)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time) AND t.asset_id=${asset:sqlstring}
    AND t.name IN (${tag:sqlstring}) AND m.quality=0
    AND ($__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom())<21600
  GROUP BY 1,3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.bucket AS time,r.avg_value AS value,t.name AS metric
  FROM measurement_1m r JOIN tag t USING(tag_id)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.bucket) AND t.asset_id=${asset:sqlstring}
    AND t.name IN (${tag:sqlstring})
    AND ($__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom())>=21600
), ordered_trend AS (
  SELECT time,value,metric,lag(time) OVER(PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time) AS previous_time
  FROM trend
), history_marks AS (
  SELECT previous_time+CASE WHEN ($__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom())>=21600
    THEN interval '1 minute' ELSE '${__interval}'::interval END AS time,
    NULL::double precision AS value,metric
  FROM ordered_trend
  WHERE time-previous_time>CASE WHEN ($__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom())>=21600
    THEN interval '1 minute' ELSE greatest('${__interval}'::interval,interval '1 minute') END
), gap_marks AS (
  SELECT greatest(g.gap_start,$__timeFrom()::timestamptz)+interval '1 microsecond' AS time,
         NULL::double precision AS value,t.name AS metric
  FROM plant_event g JOIN tag t ON t.asset_id=g.asset_id
  WHERE g.event_type='Gap' AND g.asset_id=${asset:sqlstring}
    AND t.name IN (${tag:sqlstring}) AND g.gap_end>=$__timeFrom() AND g.gap_start<=$__timeTo()
  UNION ALL
  SELECT least(g.gap_end,$__timeTo()::timestamptz)-interval '1 microsecond',NULL::double precision,t.name
  FROM plant_event g JOIN tag t ON t.asset_id=g.asset_id
  WHERE g.event_type='Gap' AND g.asset_id=${asset:sqlstring}
    AND t.name IN (${tag:sqlstring}) AND g.gap_end>=$__timeFrom() AND g.gap_start<=$__timeTo()
)
SELECT time,value,metric FROM trend
UNION ALL SELECT time,value,metric FROM gap_marks
UNION ALL SELECT time,value,metric FROM history_marks
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Collection gaps
panels.description: Durable Bridge gap events. Times are UTC; measurements are never filled across an outage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gap_start AS "Start",gap_end AS "End",
 extract(epoch FROM gap_end-gap_start) AS "Duration (s)",asset_id AS "Asset",reason AS "Reason"
FROM plant_event WHERE event_type='Gap' AND asset_id=${asset:sqlstring}
 AND gap_end>=$__timeFrom() AND gap_start<=$__timeTo()
ORDER BY gap_start DESC
